retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style cosmic illustration featuring symmetrical architectural elements like escalators leading into a star-filled void, paired with heavy chrome-effect display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, low-angle perspective of an escalator ascending into a deep black space filled with stars. The scene is rendered in a smooth airbrushed style with high-contrast reflections on metallic and glass surfaces, featuring surreal elements like a golden bird and mechanical debris.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical one-point perspective leading to a central vanishing point
Contrast between dark cosmic background and bright reflective architectural surfaces
Integration of heavy, blocky display type with the upper composition
Juxtaposition of organic forms (bird) with rigid mechanical structures
coreInvariants: High-gloss airbrushed gradients on glass panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The escalator occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, converging toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blocky display title in the top-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the escalator tracks upward toward the center, then moves to the title and the surreal bird on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by black space, providing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark teal for the space and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white for the primary typography and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and orange tones in the bird and distant horizon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark void and the bright, reflective chrome and glass surfaces.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are composed of thick, blocky strokes with rounded outer corners.
Horizontal 'speed lines' or grooves are cut into the center of the letterforms.
Heavy white outlines surround the primary yellow fill.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'E' are tightly kerned to create a continuous block.
The 'O' is a perfect rounded square with a central horizontal bar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, condensed blocky sans-serif is used for the subtitle, mirroring the mechanical feel of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration of a symmetrical escalator ascending into a black star-filled space. Use teal and cyan for the glass panels with high-gloss reflections. Include a golden bird on the right and mechanical debris on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-bold custom title in the top left. The letters should be yellow with horizontal grooves and a thick white outline. Add a smaller, condensed blocky subtitle directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective symmetrical and converging?
Does the typography have the characteristic horizontal grooves?
Is the background a deep black star-field?
Are the glass panels rendered with smooth airbrushed gradients?

adjustableVariables: Color of the glass panel reflections
mustRedesign: Exact character shapes of the original title
Specific placement of the bird and debris to avoid direct copying
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the typography is legible despite the internal grooves.
Check that the symmetry of the escalator is maintained.
Verify the high-contrast relationship between the black space and the highlights.
Confirm the airbrushed texture is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical architectural perspective + Cosmic void background + Airbrushed chrome textures + Grooved blocky display typography.
